abort.no_devices_found: No PixelJoy panels in range. Check that the panel is powered and close the PixelJoy phone app: a panel connected to the app may stop advertising.
abort.all_configured: Every PixelJoy panel in range is already set up. See Settings → Devices & services → PixelJoy LED Panel.
abort.no_connectable: A PixelJoy panel is in range, but only passive Bluetooth scanners see it. Setup needs a connectable adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy in active mode near the panel.

data_description.show_date: Alternates with the date for about 5 s every 10-15 s.

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Render text on this machine and scroll it on the panel.

text.name: Text
text.description: Up to 600 characters (100 on older firmware).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Scroll speed 0-255 (pixels advance speed/25 per frame).

rainbow.name: Rainbow scheme
rainbow.description: Rainbow colour scheme index; overrides the colour.

show_clock.name: Show clock
show_clock.description: The panel's built-in clock, drawn from its own RTC.

show_date.name: Show date
show_date.description: Alternate with the date (about 12 s time, 4 s date).

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Scale an image file to the panel and show it.

path.name: Path
path.description: Image file; must be under allowlist_external_dirs.

show_gif.name: Show GIF
show_gif.description: Upload a GIF already sized to the panel and play it.

path.name: Path
path.description: GIF file; must be under allowlist_external_dirs.

sync_time.name: Sync time
sync_time.description: Send HA's time zone, DST rules and wall clock to the panel.
